topic: Entropy Discord’s new creator roles and helping newcomers participate
rules: A post qualifies if it substantively covers at least one of these topics: (1) how Entropy’s new Discord role system works; (2) how a newcomer can earn Entropy Voices; (3) how someone progresses from Voices to Entropy Council, or explains the role of Entropy Genesis in the system; (4) personal experience in Entropy’s Discord that gives newcomers a concrete tip, lesson, or path to participate. Accept explanations and first-hand guidance in any language. A quote post can qualify through its own visible commentary. A tag, role name, shout-out, Discord invite, generic community or support announcement, product update, or generic contest instructions alone are insufficient. If the substance needed to decide appears to be in omitted images, video, a linked post, or quoted content, select review. Assess topical relevance without judging factual truth beyond what these criteria establish.
